home.title: Give objects a second life.
home.intro: UpcycleConnect brings together people who want to give, transform and reuse objects.
home.projectTitle: A platform for a different way to act
home.projectIntro: The platform is being built around three ideas: keeping objects in use, learning new practices and valuing everyone's actions.
home.giveText: Offer objects so that someone else can use them.
home.learnText: Discover advice, workshops and events about upcycling.
home.impactText: Keep track of your actions and how they support more sustainable consumption.
home.communityIntro: UpcycleConnect brings together individuals, craftspeople and teams who run workshops and events.
home.individualsText: Give objects a new purpose and discover ways to reuse them.
home.craftspeopleText: Find materials and share projects that transform them.
home.joinTitle: Would you like to take part?
home.joinText: Create an account to discover your UpcycleConnect space.

about.title: About UpcycleConnect
about.text: A platform dedicated to reuse, upcycling and sharing know-how.
